title: SupoClip vs OpusClip
caption:
OpusClip Pro costs $29 a month. SupoClip is an open source alternative. 🎬

Paste a YouTube, Twitch or Kick link. It finds the best moments, crops them vertical on the speaker's face, and adds captions. One catch: you bring your own API keys, so it's free software, but not free to run. Only clip streamers who allow it, and credit them. Not affiliated with either tool.

Pay for clips, or host your own? Comment OPEN and tag a friend who clips. Follow @StickMindR8!

#opensource #aitools #contentcreator #github #reelsinstagram
